        outlined_flag
      
    
    
      
        
          This enum describes the possible placements of an asset.

        
      
        
          Possible asset placements include headlines, descriptions, marketing images, videos, and various ad extensions.

        
      
        
          Specific placements are available for different asset types like logos, call-to-actions, and business information.

        
      
        
          Some placements are specific to campaign types such as "Book on Google" or Performance Max for travel goals.

        
      
        
          Reserved enum values exist for unspecified or unknown placements.
